feature: IS NULL / IS NOT NULL predicate — the defensive filter for envelope ORDER BY DESC queries

scenarios.name: IS NULL filter returns only the null-observed_at row
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (IS NULL selects unset values)

scenarios.name: IS NOT NULL filter excludes the null-observed_at row
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (IS NOT NULL complement)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.observed_at IS NOT NULL

scenarios.name: defensive latest-emission — IS NOT NULL filter before ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (IS NOT NULL guarding an ordered limit)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.observed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY n.data.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: IS NULL composes with AND on a second comparison
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (IS NULL composed with AND)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.observed_at IS NULL AND n.data.severity_score = 0

scenarios.name: IS NOT NULL keyword is case-insensitive — lowercase 'is not null' is identical
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/null (predicate keyword case-insensitivity: lowercase is not null behaves identically)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.observed_at is not null
